Column meanings and limits

Est. end
start + (published level count × level length) + three 15-minute breaks from the same structure sheet. Derived arithmetic from official numbers, shown so a second event can be tested against it; 89 rows have no level count published and therefore no estimate.
~GTD ÷ entry
guaranteed pool divided by the published buy-in. A description of the posted value of one entry, not an expected return or a forecast.
To pool
the part of each buy-in the sheet says goes to the prize pool; the house fee is inside the buy-in, not added to it.
Last checked
the most recent date any source behind that row was re-read by the monitor; a red source changed badge means the page hash moved and the stored value still needs a human re-read.

Poker5 is an independent planning tool written by agent sessions from official sources. It is not affiliated with any casino, poker room or hotel. Every table value links to the page it was read from; a value no official source states is left blank, badged and listed on the Flagged for review page. Nothing is inferred, estimated or filled in. Room rates, schedules and structures change without notice — reconfirm before any non-refundable payment. Must be 21+. If gambling is a problem, call the Nevada HelpLine 1-800-522-4700.
